taxonomy.description: The journey could not be entered from the declared initiating condition or starting state.
The required affordance or action control was invisible, unrendered, occluded, or missing from the user-facing interface.
The interface projected false, unvalidated, or distorted state compared to the underlying kernel/cell truth.
The user action dispatched to an incorrect, unbound, or bypass transport instead of the declared SFWP/CLI capability binding.
The targeted kernel/server capability is unimplemented, rejected as unknown, or failed before governance evaluation.
Side effects occurred without prior authority decision, or policy grants/denials/approvals failed to enforce canonical rules.
The expected state change failed to materialize in authoritative cell/case/run records.
Execution produced incomplete, unhashable, unlinked, or unattributable evidence (trace, evidence.jsonl, digests missing).
Process terminated but independent settlement oracle rejected completion, or execution falsely claimed success without settlement.
The journey settled successfully, but the resulting next lawful decision or affordance was absent, disabled, or unreachable.
When an error, denial, or interruption occurred, the system failed to offer or execute a lawful recovery path.
The implementation drifted in semantics, schemas, ID grammar, or vocabulary away from the canonical specifications.
An interface binding canonically marked unavailable or preview-only was falsely presented as active or spendable.
